questions.question_en: Which of the following is the most suitable virtue of democracy?
options_en: Liberty is possible only in a democratic society
Equality is possible only in a democratic society
Democratic system is the only way for the welfare of the people
Democracy is the most superior form of government among all the alternatives
questions.answer_text: Liberty is possible only in a democratic society
questions.language_status: English structured extraction; Telugu not included in index
questions.explanation_en: Reworded from UPSC CSP 2017 Q42; the answer here follows this wording (option 4). Answer: Democracy is the most superior form of government among all the alternatives. Democracy's most cited superiority is that it is the best system of governance compared to all known alternatives — it ensures accountability, representation, and protection of rights.
